risk_note: RV1 (notification). Push token reports now lock the reporting user's users row FOR SHARE before the devices row (lock order users -> devices -> push_tokens, the same as identity's deletion cleanup), outside the SAVEPOINT retry loop; a missing row or status deleting / deleted ignores the whole report like a non-current session (no push_tokens write, report resolves, no new error code, no token value logged) (D10-318). FOR SHARE conflicts with the cleanup's FOR NO KEY UPDATE and is compatible with login's FOR KEY SHARE. This closes the F1-02zzk review's out-of-scope S2 (a concurrent report re-inserting a token after the cleanup's delete). Rule tests by a fresh independent Claude reproduce the race (red before the fix); test-machine full verify passed. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21). Mechanical test-data change folded into the rule-test commit after the first push: sample push token strings shortened from 'pt-del-…' to 'pd-…' (under 16 characters) so gitleaks rule cn-doc-secret does not match test data; no assertion changed, gitleaks rules untouched; red re-run on the new spec commit.
